paragraphs.text: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins: real session deletion with trash, audit log and more
Plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Each one is an independent npm package, verified end to end agai

nst a real DSH host before release.
English · 中文
## Plugins
| Plugin
| What it does
| Version

| **session-delete**
screenshots | Really deletes sessions instead of just archiving them. Deleted s
essions go to a restorable trash, and the confirm dialog shows the plan first: size, sub-sessions, a
nd the references that will be cleaned. Every action goes into an audit log, and a receipt lists any
thing left behind.
| [](https://w

ww.npmjs.com/package/@kangyishuai/dsh-session-delete) |
| **session-rewind**
| Rewind a conversation in place: `Esc` `Esc` or
the ↶ button next to Copy, then choose conversation-only or conversation-plus-files. Everything fro
m the target message on is withdrawn from the model context and transcript; changed files are restor
ed with pre-write snapshots, rescue points and a trash, and the message text/images return to the co
mposer. A panel lists withdrawn messages, audit history, rescue points and diagnostics. The log is a
ppend-only. Bare `↑` / `↓` in the composer recalls prompts you already sent, without rewinding anyth
ing. | [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kangyishuai/dsh-session-rewind) |
More plugins are on the way.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then restart the DSH desktop app. Each plugin's README covers usage, side effects and compatibility.
## How these plugins are built
- **Nothing destructive without a way back.** Deletion goes to a trash first. A confirm dialog state
s the impact: count, size, whether the session is live, and whether it can be undone. See ADR 0002.
- **No hard-coded internals.** DSH is pre-release and its on-disk formats change. Plugins scan and m

atch known patterns, and leave anything they don't recognize alone.
- **Verified on a real host.** U
nit tests, plus an end-to-end GUI smoke test against a throwaway DSH home. Compatibility tables say

exactly which DSH version was checked.
- **No network, no telemetry.** Plugins only touch the local

DSH data directory, and only as documented.
- **Plain JavaScript, no build step.** What you install
is what's in the repo (ADR 0001).
> **Disclaimer:** this is a personal community project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Dee
pSeek. Plugins are young software, so keep backups of anything you can't lose.
## Contributing
Issues and PRs are welcome. Start with CONTRIBUTING.md, which covers setup, commands, commit convent
ions and the release flow. Design notes live in docs/ (in Chinese).
## Security
Please report vulnerabilities privately. See SECURITY.md.
